game.name: pudge-wars
game.description: Two banks split by a river, six butchers, one hook. First team to 30 wins. Fog on the enemy bank. Platform-ladder 3v3 clone teams, plus a sibling 1v1 duel league.

player.value: Connect to COWORLD_PLAYER_WS_URL. One observation per tick after the sim step; the reply is applied on the next tick (fixed 1-tick latency) before that tick's observation is built. Reply with {walk_to, hook_to, blink_to, attack_target, rot, place_wall, place_mine, place_ward, halt, ping, buy_upgrade, buy_power, print}. rot is a set (true|false), not a toggle; rot_toggle still works. buy_upgrade is 0 damage / 1 distance / 2 speed / 3 radius (int or array). buy_power is the shop catalog 0-9 (own pad); self.items / self.item_ranks are the five permanent ranks (treads, longflight, palisade, hooktrap, ward) occupying a six-well bag (a planted ward frees its well). self.upgrades, self.rot, self.shield (ticks), self.buff (kind+1), and self.blink_ready (cooldown, windup, hooked, and rot) match the in-engine checks. accepted echoes only what the previous reply asked ({hook_to: true, blink_to: "cooldown", buy_upgrade: [true, "points"]}; arrays echo as arrays). print is the intent bubble, echoed on self.say/say_tick. river_west/river_east are inclusive water columns; play_west_max/play_east_min are the land lips BASIC riverWest/riverEast use. objects is the flat fog-clipped BASIC list (roster pudges then props; kind 1 butcher, 2 wall, 3 mine, 4 ward). ally_ping carries age in ticks. Coordinates are tiles on the 128 map. game_version is the replay/simulator version (37 in this release). Base HP is 1200. Blink has a 20-tile range and may cross the river near the fountain when its destination is clear land; only the landing point is collision-tested, and landing on the fountain remains blocked. Empty action is sticky. visible.pudges/hooks/runes/props are fog-clipped (home bank + river always; enemy bank needs a living teammate within 20 tiles). Seats 0-2 West, 3-5 East (team_pair blocks). Final message type=final. Farwatch Ward (shop item 9) is now a free consumable charge: at most one carried, 60-second shop restock exposed as self.ward_restock, 32-tile Chebyshev placement on either bank, and a 45-second lifetime. Planting consumes the charge. visible.fires contains public Lightning fire patches with owner_id, team, x, y and ticks; hostile trails deal periodic damage. Lightning throws fly and reel at double hook speed. Fire trails come from the charged hook only (not walking or blink) and light the thrower's team through fog. Existing player action keys remain supported.

global.value: GET /client/player and /client/global open the version-pinned WASM game (native 3D renderer) over the binary /ws endpoint. The browser launcher preserves Softmax proxy paths and player seat credentials from address=. JSON policies still connect to /player. Observatory replays use the same WASM bundle with index.html?replay=<url>. The public replay copy is gzip; the viewer sniffs 1f 8b.

readme.value:
# Pudge Wars

Two banks, a river, six butchers, one hook. League 3v3 is first to 30 kills within twenty minutes at 32 Hz; Duel 1v1 is first to 10 within eight minutes. A base hook deals 200 damage against 1,200 HP. Use walk_to, hook_to, blink_to, rot, buy_upgrade and buy_power. Fog hides the enemy bank until an ally or ward supplies vision.

This release is simulator 37. Lightning throws fly and reel at double hook speed. Fire trails come from the charged hook only, pulse hostile damage, and light the thrower's team through fog. It keeps 1,200 HP, 20-tile fountain Blink crossings (landing on the fountain stays blocked), red/blue butcher models, stone terrain and lava visuals, policy nameplates, the six-slot inventory, free consumable Farwatch Wards, and chain-clash shocks. A ward is picked up at the shop, plants up to 32 tiles away, lasts 45 seconds, and restocks after 60 seconds.

Bundled Rusher uses the improved Base Python policy with deliberate ally healing, separated fishing lanes, team recovery from below 40% HP until 75%, and guarded fountain escapes toward its home bank; Camper and Sniper retain their own strategies. Docker policy hosting and the existing JSON action protocol remain supported. The WASM replay and human client is built with the same simulator as the game image.

player.name: Camper
player.description: Holds 16 tiles off the waterline. Spends kill points into damage then reach, blinks to dodge and stretch, and hooks the most likely far-bank ghost when fogged.

player.name: Rusher
player.description: Base-derived policy with predictive hooks, defensive Blink, ally-safe throws and rescues, deliberate healing, stable fishing lanes, one rune collector, sustained team recovery, safe fountain escapes, and shop upgrades.

player.name: Sniper
player.description: Standoff thrower. Spends kill points into hook distance, saves the hook for wounded or high-likelihood ghosts, blinks inland off inbound chains, never dives.
